structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions
The Virginia Higher Education Opportunity Act of 2011

law.catch_line: Public institutions of higher education; targeted economic and innovation incentives

text.section: The Governor and the General Assembly shall consider maintenance of effort initiatives for individual institutions with unique missions and demonstrable performance in specific incentive areas identified pursuant to subsection A.

The criteria for measuring whether the incentive areas in subsection A have been met, and the benefits or consequences for meeting or not meeting such incentive areas, shall be developed and reviewed as provided in subdivisions B 3 and 4 of § 23.1-309.
